title: YouTube and Pixel Recorder exposed cross-product identity links
summary: One cross-product privacy report received USD 3,133 and a USD 7,500 adjustment, totaling USD 10,633.
root_cause: Cross-product identifier exposure and insufficient field-level privacy controls weakened account pseudonymity.
impact: Researchers reported that private email addresses associated with YouTube users could be revealed. No mass breach is established.
defensive_takeaways: Treat cross-product identifiers as sensitive correlation data.
Require entitlement before returning identity attributes.
Verify remediation across every affected component.

reward.evidence_quote: Panel awards $3,133 … Panel awards an additional $7,500
reward.evidence_location: Timeline, November 5 and December 12, 2024; ellipsis joins excerpts
reward.notes: One report: December 3 entry explicitly says it returned for additional reward consideration. Headline rounds to $10,000. Exact arithmetic is $10,633. USD uses Google web VRP denomination documented by google-usd-context. Awarded, not confirmed paid.

awarded.note: Final additional award; initial award was November 5, 2024.

fixed.note: Researcher confirmed both components fixed on February 9, 2025; actual deployment date is not supplied.

recency.note: Historical reference outside the preferred last-12-month publication window.

sources.title: Leaking the email of any YouTube user for $10,000
sources.author: Arvin Shivram and Nathan

sources.title: Google and Alphabet VRP reward-denomination announcement, July 11, 2024
sources.author: Sam Erb and Krzysztof Kotowicz / Google

verification.method: Primary source reviewed; individual award and attribution checked. Historical defensive summary only. Official 2024 program announcement was read in the cloud browser for USD denomination only; its advertised maximum is not award evidence.
limitations: Award evidence is not an independently audited cash receipt.
The source uses dollar notation, with USD established from Google program context.
No public report ID, recipient split, or exact fix-deployment date is provided.
Separate from the March 2025 creator-metadata report and its USD 20,000 award.
